addition_rules.nucleus: Founder decision plus ADR amendment plus taxonomy version bump. The new nucleus needs a unique ASCII id and every required field. A nucleus is not a sub-brand, domain or second identity model.
addition_rules.offer: The finite offer catalog owns commercial records. An offer references an existing nucleus_id; a missing nucleus fails closed. This taxonomy stores offer_id only and never duplicates price, SLA or checkout.
addition_rules.route: Every indexable public route stays in public-family-registry with visitor job, terminal action and conversion-gate coverage. MV-09 applies shared-registry integration; this producer does not edit that file.
addition_rules.location: Geography is a qualification field, not a nucleus or doorway-page multiplier. National availability never overrides local professional formalities.
addition_rules.proof: Proof items need source, date and permission class. Invented credentials, rankings, cases or seals fail closed. extra-cli owns facts when acquisition is required.

route_bindings.notes: Current production home remains the B2G vertical surface until MV-09 integrates an approved public information architecture.

b2g_coexistence.cannibalization: New service families must not rewrite, redirect or noindex B2G URLs. Public navigation may expose only approved buyer-language intent families after MV-09 integrates the information architecture; internal nucleus names are not public route truth.
b2g_coexistence.url_policy: Preserve current B2G routes, indexation and conversion. No blanket redirect to home. MIGRATE/REDIRECT/RETIRE remains URL-exact.
b2g_coexistence.equity_policy: B2G content, offers, proof and data remain in force. The vertical is not deprecated and is not the corporate category.

sibling_contracts.notes: Sibling contracts are consumed by MV-03 through MV-07 and integrated only by MV-09. They are not runtime fallbacks. Missing or divergent taxonomy version/hash fails closed.
